Consequence: DIRECTIVE-20260531-008 sat status=pending for 7 days and would have been re-picked (and re-no-oped) by every directive-discovery scan; PROP-069 showed design-pending-operator-review while its code had been live for a week. Root cause class: same as the PROP-053 closure-HNOTE loss — multi-step terminal work (push, then flip lifecycle) where the run ends after the push. Mitigation already in force for artifacts (PROP-081 pre-push hook); lifecycle flips have no equivalent gate. Recommendation: when a directive's requested_work ends in lifecycle flips, perform the flips in the SAME commit as the implementation push, never as a separate post-push step.
